about_the_game:
VAMPIRE HUNTING MEETS CREATURE COLLECTOR

Step into the role of a cunning and ruthless vampire slayer, armed with silver bullets that can turn foes into loyal servants.
As the moon rises higher, so too does your power. Seize control of haunted castles and corrupted lands, every battle draws you closer to the truth behind your strength.

CREATE YOUR OWN PATH

Use the gifts of the Arcana to augment and transform your powers. Adapt and discover powerful synergies between your abilities and servants to overcome challenges in this brutal turn-based RPG.

SHAPED BY THE NIGHT

As a seasoned Vampire hunter, each hunt will allow you to master new weapons and collect build-changing artifacts to become permanently stronger as you conquer more lands in Restless Hallow.

BOUND BY BLOOD & SILVER

Build your collection of fiends, demons, and werewolves, each with distinct traits and specialties. Maintain unique team compositions or expand and replace your servants as you fight in 3v3 strategic turn-based combat,

FEATURE LIST

  • Innovative Capture System: Defeat and tame over 50 unique enemies as servants with silver bullets, altering combat dynamics in each encounter.

  • Gothic Visual Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a darkly atmospheric world, created with hand placed retro style pixel art.

  • Modular Ability Upgrades: Create unique abilities by stacking different upgrades with every play-through, ensuring no two hunts are alike.

  • Brutal Strategic Combat: Master tactical 3v3 battles where positioning is crucial and careful resource management is needed to survive.

short_description: Capture the wicked and bend them to your will in this turn-based roguelite monster tamer. Use enemies as your servants, sacrifice them to reach newer heights. Adapt and augment your abilities as you take control of the ever-changing lands of Restless Hollow.
